paragraphs.text: ወይእዜሰ፡ ወልድየ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘንተ፡ እነግረከ፡ ወእጽሕፈከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለከ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ወወሀብኩከ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ እሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəʾəzē-sa waldə-ya Mātusālā kwəlo zanta ʾənaggərə-ka wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka kwəlo la-ka kaśatku wa-wahabku-ka maṣḥafa ba-ʾənta kwəlu ʾəllu

i18n.en: And now, my son Methuselah, I am telling you all this and writing it for you; I have disclosed all to you, and have given you the book concerning all these things.

paragraphs.text: ዕቀብ፡ ወልድየ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ዘንተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ እምነ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ወታኅሥሥ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ʿəqab waldə-ya Mātusālā zanta maṣḥafa ʾəmənna ʾədēhu la-ʾabuka wa-tāḫśəśś la-təwlədomu ʿālam

i18n.en: Keep, my son Methuselah, this book from the hand of your father, and hand it on to the generations of the world.

paragraphs.text: ጥበበ፡ ወሀብኩከ፡ ለከ፡ ወለውሉድከ፡ ወለእለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ከመ፡ ይሁቡ፡ ለውሉዶሙ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ዘጥበብ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ እምነ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡
paragraphs.translit: ṭəbab-a wahabku-ka la-ka wa-la-wəludə-ka wa-la-ʾəlla yəkawwənu wəludə-ka kama yəhabu la-wəludomu la-təwlədomu zaṭəbab zayətgabbar ʾəmənna ḫolaqomu la-ḍaḥay wa-warḫ wa-kawākəbt

i18n.en: I have given wisdom to you and to your children, and to those who shall be your children, that they may give it to their children and to their generations — wisdom which is wrought from the reckoning of the sun and the moon and the stars.

paragraphs.text: ברירין כל צדיקיא ברירין אלין די מהלכין באורח קושטא ולית בהון חטאן כאלין חיביא בחושבן יומיא די הוה שמשא מהלך בשמיא בתרעין שתא וקדמיתיהון
paragraphs.translit: běrīrīn kol ṣaddīqayyāʾ běrīrīn ʾillēn dī měhalkīn bě-ʾōraḥ qōšṭāʾ wě-lēt běhōn ḥaṭāʾīn ke-ʾillēn ḥayyābayyāʾ bě-ḥūšbān yōmayyāʾ dī hăwāʾ šimšāʾ měhalek bi-šmayyāʾ bě-tarʿīn šittāʾ wě-qadmāyēhōn

i18n.en: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are those who walk in the way of righteousness and have no sin like the sinners in the reckoning of the days during which the sun travels in the heaven through the six gates and through what is before them.

paragraphs.commentary:
**THE BEATITUDE-POLEMIC — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q211 + 4Q209 frag 28).** This verse is the central calendrical-polemic-as-beatitude statement of the Astronomical Book: keeping the right (364-day solar) calendar = righteousness; using the wrong (lunar) calendar = sin. The beatitude-formula (*běrīrīn kol ṣaddīqayyāʾ* 'blessed are all the righteous') frames the calendrical-choice as a moral-religious choice with eternal consequences.

The verse is preserved in the Aramaic 4Q211 + 4Q209 frag 28 in fuller form than the Ge'ez transmission preserves. The polemical-edge is one of the sharpest in the Second-Temple-period Jewish corpus: the calendar-dispute is framed in beatitude-and-curse register, parallel to the Jubilees 6:32-38 polemic and the broader Qumran-Enochic-Jubilees identity-marker tradition.

See central entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus` for the systematic treatment of the calendrical-identity-keystone status of the 364-day solar calendar.

paragraphs.text: וטעין בהון אלין ארבעת יומיא די מסתפין לשנת שמשא די לא חשבין בהון עם מלכות שמשא ועם מלכות כוכביא
paragraphs.translit: wě-ṭāʿēn běhōn ʾillēn ʾarbaʿat yōmayyāʾ dī mistappīn lě-šěnat šimšāʾ dī lāʾ ḥāšbīn běhōn ʿim malkūt šimšāʾ wě-ʿim malkūt kōkěbayyāʾ

i18n.en: And they err concerning them — these four days that are added to the solar year — those who do not reckon them with the dominion of the sun and with the dominion of the stars.

paragraphs.commentary: **The four-epact-days polemic in Aramaic — the sharpest articulation.** Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q211). The verse states explicitly the calendrical-error that the polemic targets: the failure to count the four epact-days (the days that bring the schematic 360-day base year to 364) within the dominion of the sun and the stars. The polemic targets the proto-Rabbinic / Pharisaic / Temple-Establishment tradition that did not count these four days as part of the solar calendrical-system. The Aramaic preservation of the polemic in fuller form than the Ge'ez is consistent with the witness-fullness-inversion pattern documented at the per-translation overlay.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኢይኄልቍዎሙ፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለዓመት፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኮኑ፡ ለበበ፡ ጥዕና፡ ዘዓመት፡ እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወኢየአምሩ፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ዓመት፡ ግን፡ ጻድቅ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወመጽሐፍ፡ ይኄልቅ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጻድቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma sabʾ ʾiyəḫēlqəwwomu baba ḫolaqomu la-ʿāmat yəsḥətu kiyāhomu konu laba-ṭəʿnā za-ʿāmat ʾəsma sabʾ yəsḥətu kiyāhomu wa-ʾiyaʾəmru baba ḫolaqomu laba-ʿāmat gənn ṣādəq yəsamməʿ kiyāhomu wa-maṣḥaf yəḫēlləq kiyāhomu ṣādəq

i18n.en: For humans do not count them in the reckoning of the year, and they err concerning them; these are for the well-being of the year. For humans go astray concerning them and do not know them in the reckoning of the year. But the righteous shall heed them, and the book shall reckon them rightly.

paragraphs.commentary: **The righteous-shall-heed-them — the closing polemical articulation.** This verse closes the calendrical-polemic section with the righteous-vs-sinners distinction made explicit: the righteous keep the right calendar (counting the four epact-days within the dominion of the sun and stars); the sinners fail to count them. The 'book shall reckon them rightly' invokes the heavenly-tablets framework of 1 En 81: the cosmic-record will preserve the correct calendrical reckoning for the righteous against the sinners' erroneous reckoning. The polemical-cluster of 72:32 + 74:11-12 + 75:1-3 + 82:4-6 forms the foundational textual-articulation of the 364-day-solar-calendar identity-marker in the Astronomical Book.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ ብርሃናት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕልት፡ ኮኑ፡ ለበበ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ ይትዐጻዑ፡ ለሎቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma bərhānāt ʾəmuntu wa-warḫ wa-ḫolaqomu la-mawāʿəlt konu laba-manbarātihu la-ḍaḥay wa-kawākəbt yətʿaḍḍāʿu lalotu

i18n.en: For they are luminaries, with the moon; and the reckoning of the days belongs to them, according to the stations of the sun; and the stars are appointed for it.

paragraphs.text: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ሕገጊሆሙ፡ ወለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyānihomu zayəkawwən lāʿla mangəśtomu laba-ḥəgagihomu wa-laba-gizēhomu

i18n.en: And these are the names of their leaders who are over their dominion, according to their laws and according to their times.

paragraphs.text: አርባዕቱ፡ መራኅት፡ እለ፡ ይትፈልጡ፡ አርባዕተ፡ ክፍላተ፡ ዓመት፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ ለአውራኅ፡ ወሰለስቱ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾarbāʿtu marāḫət ʾəlla yətfaḷaṭu ʾarbāʿta kəfəlāta ʿāmat yəqawwəmu dəḫrēhomu śallastu marāḫət la-ʾawrāḫ wa-salāstu dəḫrēhomu la-mawāʿəl

i18n.en: Four leaders, who distinguish the four parts of the year, are set in their places; and after them three leaders of the months, and three after them of the days.

paragraphs.text: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ሰማን፡ ወያን፡ ቄሊል፡ ወሄሊአምሞ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyānihomu zayəkawwən lāʿla ḫolaqomu la-mawāʿəl Saman wa-Yān Qēlil wa-Hēliʾamamo

i18n.en: And these are the names of their leaders who are over the reckoning of the days: Saman, and Yan, Qelil, and Heliyammamo.

paragraphs.text: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያን፡ እለ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ መልክኤል፡ ወኤልሜኤል፡ ወሄላምሜሌክ፡ ወሜሌጄል፡ ወናርኤል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyān ʾəlla məslēhomu Malkəʾēl wa-ʾElməʾēl wa-Hēlamamēlek wa-Mēlējēl wa-Nārəʾēl

i18n.en: And the names of the leaders who are with them: Melkiel, and Elmeel, and Helemmelek, and Meleyal, and Narel.

paragraphs.commentary:
**The four season-leader angel-names — Melkiel, Helemmelek, Meleyal, Narel.** The four named season-leaders are the angelic-administrative-leaders of the four 91-day quarters of the 364-day solar year (cf. ch 75). The Ge'ez witness preserves a five-name list (Melkiel, Elmeel, Helemmelek, Meleyal, Narel) where the system expects four; the modern critical reconstruction (Charles 1912; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012) identifies the canonical four as Melkiel (first quarter), Helemmelek (second quarter), Meleyal (third quarter), Narel (fourth quarter). The fifth name (Elmeel) is likely a scribal-doublet inflation. The WoH translation preserves the Ge'ez verbatim per the per-verse layered-witness convention.

The theophoric *-ʾēl* ending follows the standard Hebrew/Aramaic angelological pattern (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Sariel). The four season-leaders are the next-level-subordinates of Uriel (the overall cosmic-administrative-angel over the luminaries) in the Astronomical Book's angelological hierarchy.

paragraphs.text: ወይከውን፡ መንገሊሆሙ፡ ለመንግሥቶሙ፡ አሐደ፡ ለለ፡ አሐዱ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ድኅረ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ዘመዋዕልት፡ አሐደ፡ ለለ፡ አሐዱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəkawwən mangalihomu la-mangəśtomu ʾaḥada lala ʾaḥadu zayəkawwən dəḫra mangəśtomu la-marāḫət zamawāʿəlt ʾaḥada lala ʾaḥadu

i18n.en: And the paths of their dominion are one for each one — after their dominion come the leaders of the days, one for each.

paragraphs.text: ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ ይትፈልጡ፡ ምሳለ፡ መሣክወ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምሳለ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ለበበ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ዘመንበራቲሁ፡ ካዕበ፡ ለለመንበር፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ እለ፡ ኮኑ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: śallastu marāḫət yətfaḷaṭu məsāla masākəwa səbʿa məsāla manbarātihu la-ḍaḥay laba-məśrāq zamanbarātihu kāʿba lala-manbar laba-gizēhu śallastu marāḫət ʾəlla konu dəḫrēhomu la-marāḫət laba-gizēhomu

i18n.en: Three leaders are distinguished after the manner of the seven windows, after the manner of the stations of the sun in each east, of his stations again — for each station in its time; three leaders who come after the leaders, each in their times.

paragraphs.text: ለቀዳማይ፡ ክፍለ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትለዐሉ፡ መልክኤል፡ ወእሉ፡ መራኅያኒሁ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ክፍለ፡ ዓመት፡ መልክኤል፡ ዘይትበሀል፡ ጸፋዳ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ወፀለለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ መልዕልተ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለሰብዐ፡ ምሥራቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: la-qadāmāyə kəfla ʿāmat yətlaʿalu Malkəʾēl wa-ʾəllu marāḫəyānihu la-qadāmāyə kəfla ʿāmat Malkəʾēl zayətbahal Ṣafādā mangəśtu wa-ḍallala mangəśtu malʿəlta manbaromu la-səbʿa məśrāq

i18n.en: Over the first part of the year is set Melkiel; and these are his leaders for the first part of the year. Melkiel, who is called Tsefada — his dominion and the shadow of his dominion are over the stations of the seven [windows of the] east.

paragraphs.text: በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ይከውን፡ ዘይምሉ፡ መልዕልተ፡ ምድር፡ ምክፋላት፡ ሐመስቱ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ብዙኃን፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-mawāʿəlihu yəkawwən zayəməllu malʿəlta mədr məkfālāt ḥamastu ʿaśartu sədəstu məkfālāt bərhānomu la-mawāʿəl bəzuḫān

i18n.en: In his days there is upon the earth a fullness of fifteen parts; the sixteen parts of their light are for many days.

paragraphs.text: በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃን፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወመዋዕልት፡ ይነውሑ፡ ወአራዊት፡ ወጥይም፡ ይትከበቡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይከውን፡ መዋዕል፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ይነውሕ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-mawāʿəlihu yəkawwən bərhān lāʿla mədr wa-mawāʿəlt yənawwəḥu wa-ʾarāwit wa-ṭəyəm yətkababu lāʿla mədr wa-yəkawwən mawāʿəl la-mawāʿəl yənawwəḥ

i18n.en: In his days there is light upon the earth, and the days lengthen; and the beasts and the herbs spread out over the earth; and day grows longer than day.

paragraphs.text: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ እለ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ቤርቤኤል፡ ወዘላቤኤል፡ ወሣልስ፡ ዘያትዌሰክ፡ ዘይሰምዮ፡ ሄሌአሞ፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ ምራኅቲሆሙ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫət ʾəlla dəḫrēhu Bērbēʾēl wa-Zalābēʾēl wa-śāləs zayātwēsak zayəsamməyo Hēlēʾamamo wa-mawāʿəla mərāḫətihomu yətfēṣamu

i18n.en: And these are the names of the leaders who are after him: Berbeel, and Zalabeel, and the third, who is added, whose name is Heleyammamo; and the days of their leading are completed.

paragraphs.text: ካልዕ፡ መርሕ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ሄለሜሌክ፡ ስሙ፡ ዘጻድቅ፡ ብርሃን፡ ይጼውዕዎ፡
paragraphs.translit: kāləʿ marḥ dəḫrēhu Hēlamamēlek səmu zaṣādəq bərhān yəṣēwwəʿwwo

i18n.en: The next leader after him is Helemmelek, whose name they call 'the resplendent light.'

paragraphs.text: ወመዋዕሊሁ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ መዋዕልት፡ ይነውሑ፡ ወሌሊት፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ወሕግጋቲሁ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ድርቅ፡ ወሞቅ፡ ወአራዊት፡ ይምልኡ፡ ወብርሃን፡ ይነውኅ፡ ወሌሊት፡ ይሕጽጽ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-mawāʿəlihu la-mangəśtu mawāʿəlt yənawwəḥu wa-lēlit yaḥaḍḍəḍ wa-ḥəgagāttihu la-mangəśtu yəkawwən dərq wa-moq wa-ʾarāwit yəməllu wa-bərhān yənawwəḫ wa-lēlit yəḥaḍḍəḍ

i18n.en: And in the days of his dominion the days lengthen and the night is shortened; and the laws of his dominion bring drought and heat, and the beasts multiply, and the light lengthens, and the night is shortened.

paragraphs.text: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ጊዳኤል፡ ወቄኤል፡ ወሄኤል፡ ወስሙ፡ ለመርሐ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ዘይትዌሰክ፡ አስፋኤል፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫət dəḫrēhu Gidāʾēl wa-Qēʾēl wa-Hēʾēl wa-səmu la-marḥa dəḫrēhomu zayətwēsak ʾAsfaʾēl wa-mawāʿəla mangəśtu yətfēṣamu

i18n.en: And these are the names of the leaders after him: Gidael, and Keel, and Heel; and the name of the leader who is added after them is Asphael; and the days of his dominion are completed.

paragraphs.commentary:
**The Ge'ez ends abruptly mid-pattern — Aramaic 4Q211 preserves continuation beyond Ge'ez.** This verse closes the Ge'ez witness of the Astronomical Book at the summer-quarter (Helemmelek) section. The Aramaic 4Q211 fragments preserve a continuation beyond the Ge'ez ending — confirming Milik 1976's hypothesis that the original Aramaic Astronomical Book extended substantially further into autumn/winter quarter-leader material. The witness-fullness-inversion is consistent with the broader pattern documented at the per-translation overlay (`aramaic-fuller-than-geez-lunar-tables-4q208-convention`): the Aramaic preserves more text than the Ge'ez, suggesting the original Astronomical Book was substantially longer than what the Ge'ez tradition has transmitted.

The Ge'ez of v. 20 closes the chapter abruptly; the surviving 4Q211 Aramaic continuation has not been integrated into the WoH translation surface text (per the per-verse layered-witness convention, the Aramaic-only extra-Ge'ez material would require an appendix-extension; the WoH translation restricts to verses with Ge'ez parallel). The textual-witness situation is documented for the Reviewer's evaluation.
